html:
The son of Gnassingbe Eyadema, installed as president of Togo by the army on his father's death in February 2005.

Under pressure from ECOWAS and the African Union he stepped down and ran in an election in April 2005, which he won amid violence in which several hundred people were killed, mostly opposition supporters. He has won every election since. In 2024 a new constitution made Togo a parliamentary republic, and he took the top post of the new system, which critics said would let him rule without term limits. The Gnassingbe family has held power in Lome since 1967.
sum: The son of Gnassingbe Eyadema, installed as president of Togo by the army on his father's death in February 2005.
